inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or weaken the edge if electrical orders or backlog contract, data-center projects are cancelled or delayed, customer concentration or over-ordering impairs demand quality, margins compress, cash conversion weakens, or acquisition leverage constrains returns.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Higher-density data centers require switchgear, distribution, power quality, thermal management and related electrical infrastructure; Eaton can transmit this demand into electrical orders, backlog, revenue, margins and cash, subject to acquisition leverage, project timing and customer concentration.

objective: Refresh the accepted Eaton relationship to AI infrastructure and power bottlenecks after the already-queued security review, using current electrical demand, backlog, margin, cash-flow, leverage and concentration evidence.
